item.tib: bdud rtsi g.yu 'brang phyug mo'i khro bo mthar thug gis mngon rtogs nyi ma'i snying po
item.coloph: de ltar bdud rtsi g.yu 'brang phyug mo yi/ khro bo mthar thug gi mngon rtogs 'di/ rgyal ba'i lung dang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes la/ rang gis (gi) rig pa'i (pas) gsal gdabs/ phyi rabs dad ldan bsnyen bsgrubs myur len gyis don du/ gshen gyis (gyi) drangs (drang) srong tshul khrims 'od zer gyis/ dmu rigs gshen gyis (gyi) gnas mchog/ bkra shis khri brtan nor bu'i rtse yis (yi) khrod du sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so/ tshigs (tshig) don sdeb nyes 'gal 'khrul ci mchis skyabs yul tshogs la bzod par gsol/ de dag las byung dus gsum dge rtsa rnams/ mkha' mnyam don du byung (byang) chub bsngo 'bras ni/ khams gsum dong sprug sku gsum myur thobs shog (thob shog)/
